notes: The registered diagnose/diag/glance entry shares C's POS_RESTING gate; the focused registry test pins all three names (R1/R2/R5e).
With no explicit target and no FIGHTING pointer, C emits only Diagnose who? (R1/R3/R5e).
A visible horse resolves through get_char_room_vis and receives the capitalized full-health diagnostic line (R1/R3/R5e).
one_argument consumes only the first token, so trailing words do not alter the diagnostic target (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
C lowercases one_argument before its visible room lookup; uppercase HORSE resolves identically (R1/R3/R5e).
An explicit target miss emits the exact NOPERSON line and returns before diag_char_to_char (R1/R3/R5e).
The Go alias diag reaches the same do_diagnose behavior as C's table-prefix resolution (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
The explicit C glance row shares do_diagnose and emits the same target diagnostic (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
A sleeping actor is rejected by the POS_RESTING dispatcher gate before target lookup (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
A visible player target receives the exact full-health condition line with PERS/CAP formatting (R1/R3/R5e).
diag_char_to_char uses send_to_char only: target and same-room observer receive no bytes (R1/R3/R5e).
The player target remains selected when trailing argument words follow the first token (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
diag and glance preserve the same private player-target output as diagnose (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
The focused test covers every inclusive percentage boundary plus C's max-hit<=0 negative-percent branch (R1/R3/R5e).
With an empty argument, FIGHTING(ch) supplies the target; the result remains a single private diagnostic (R1/R3/R5e).
A target at 95% of maximum hit points reads "has a few scratches." through do_diagnose.
A target at 80% reads "has some small wounds and bruises.".
A target at 60% reads "has quite a few wounds.".
A target at 40% reads "has some big nasty wounds and scratches.".
A target at 20% reads "looks pretty hurt.".
A target at 10% reads "is in awful condition.".

Dead in C: percent is -1 only when GET_MAX_HIT is not positive, but set maxhit clamps RANGE(1, 5000) (C answered "maxhit set to 1." for input 0) and no mobile in lib/world/mob carries zero hit dice, so no body can hold a non-positive maximum.
